integrity: The regular-graph classification is exhaustive over all labeled degree-2 and degree-3 graphs on eight vertices. Cayley--Menger identities are checked in exact integer arithmetic and then used in an analytic all-real-parameter argument; no numerical experiment is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to nondegenerate Euclidean 7-simplices with at most two edge lengths. It does not settle the general dimension-7 case, dimensions above 7, or the all-centers version of the conjecture.
title: Two-distance \(7\)-simplices satisfy the precise center conjecture
